Eligibility Criteria
Users may be eligible to claim voting power if they belong to any of the following groups:
Early users of Element Finance
: Individuals who have used the Element protocol to provide liquidity (LP), trade, or mint.
Community contributors
: Users who have engaged in meaningful conversations on Element’s Discord server.
Ecosystem contributors
: Builders who have contributed to the public goods infrastructure supporting the Ethereum blockchain.
For detailed eligibility criteria and claim guides, refer to the official
Element Protocol Airdrop Documentation
.
Important Links
Official Announcement:
Element Protocol Airdrop Documentation

Element’s Council Dashboard
Additional Information
To claim voting power:
Visit
Element’s Council Dashboard
and connect your wallet.
If eligible, a ‘Claim’ button will appear in the ‘Portfolio’ section and the sidebar menu.
Follow the on-screen instructions to select a delegate for your voting power. You can:
Choose from a list of ‘Featured Delegates’.
Self-delegate.
Enter a valid wallet address to delegate your votes.
Review your claimable amount and delegate information, then confirm the transaction in your web3 wallet (note: gas fees apply).
Upon successful transaction, your ELFI tokens will be deposited into the locking Voting Vault, enabling you to participate in governance proposals.
For more detailed instructions, consult the
Airdrop Claim Guide
.
